one_line: Three numbered questions on screen from frame zero over a hands-only book: a tip that needs no voice or child.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 top-down static shot: a hand swings a green picture-book cover open on a wooden table. Four pale text boxes already on screen: the headline "3 שאלות שהייתי שואלת כדי לפתח TOM" and three questions. No speech.
q1_hook.why: A counted promise with the questions visible from frame zero meets the skip test (H1, T3) with the book handled at once (S1). But it is text only, so no voice or face (H4, H6), "TOM" is unexplained until the caption (H2), and nothing is held back to open a gap (H5).

beats.what: A hand swings the green cover open under four text boxes
beats.why: The whole promise is readable at once.

beats.what: A town-square spread with a tall figure, held about 4 s; text unchanged
beats.why: Time to read the questions, but nothing new appears.

beats.what: Page turns to a clothes spread with a window picture; text unchanged
beats.why: A new picture, the only change on screen.

beats.what: Another page is mid-turn when the Reel ends
beats.why: The ending is abrupt, with no wrap-up.

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None. The caption repeats the three questions and suggests asking more and linking the story to real life, but asks nobody to comment, send or save.
q2_flow.why: All three questions are readable at 0:00 and then nothing changes except a page turn, so once read there is little reason to stay (R3, H5). The Reel is short enough to finish (R1, R2). A numbered, reusable list is worth saving and forwarding (R7, R5), though nobody is asked.

q3_cta.what: None. No spoken or written ask in the video, and none in the caption, which ends with a remark about comparing the story to real life.
q3_cta.why: A useful tip with no next step: no question to answer, no send or save prompt, no follow. A specific question to parents would give a comment a purpose (C5), and a named person to send it to would help (C4). A save prompt would match the list (R7).

q4_shown.what: Hands only on a wooden table: a hand with a bracelet turns the green cover, then open pages (a town square with a tall figure, a spread of clothes). Four text boxes sit over the pages throughout. No child, face or price.
q4_shown.why: The book is handled from frame 0 (S1), and hands only keeps any child off screen (S4, S5). The expert role rests on the jargon "TOM" and the account handle, with no child answering the questions (S6). The boxes cover the pictures, so the book is seen through the text (F4, T2).

q5_edit.what: One shot of 7.8 s, no cuts, static camera, text boxes fixed throughout. The only change is the hand turning pages: cover 0:00, town spread 0:01 to 0:04, clothes spread 0:05, a turn at 0:07. No speech. Ends mid page-turn.
q5_edit.why: One take with fixed text is easy to film, and 8 s is short (R1, R2). With no cut or new text, only page turns change the screen (E2, R3). Nothing is timed to sound (E4). The ending is a half-turned page, not a payoff (E8).

q6_topic.what: Three questions to ask while reading one picture book, to build understanding of the intention behind words (TOM). Serves a parent who wants more from read-aloud time.
q6_topic.why: Reusable questions turn reading time into something a parent can try tonight (K4) and are worth saving or forwarding (R5, R7). The term and the developmental idea are explained only in the caption, and the claim is modest (K4). Calm information with no emotional peak (K1).

q7_filmed.what: Static top-down phone shot of an open picture book on a light wooden table in daylight, one hand with a bracelet turning pages. No face, no child.
q7_filmed.why: Top-down hands on the book is the easy, child-free format (S4, F5, S5), full-screen and sharp (F1, F3), evenly lit and steady (F7). The pages are mostly covered by the text boxes, so little of the book can be read at phone size (F4).

q8_text.on_screen: Four pale rounded boxes with dark bold text, fixed for all 7.8 s: headline "3 שאלות שהייתי שואלת כדי לפתח TOM באמצעות הענק הכי גנדרן בעולם 📚" about 32% down; "1. מה הענק אומר?" at 50%; "2. למה הוא באמת מתכוון?" at 62%; "3. למה החיה חושבת שהוא מתכוון?" at 73%. No subtitles, no CTA.
q8_text.caption: "📚 הענק הכי גנדרן בעולם". About 130 words: what TOM is, how the giant behaves, the same three questions with 💭, a suggestion to extend them, a closing line. No CTA, no hashtags, no disclosure.
q8_text.why: Short numbered questions in dark text on pale boxes are readable and fixed long enough (T5, T1), but they cover the pictures (T2) and the third sits in the bottom 35% (T4, F2). The headline starts with a digit and holds Latin "TOM" (T6). The caption explains the term but has no hashtags (T7).

weak_points: Everything is on screen at 0:00, so nothing builds; boxes cover the pictures and the third sits in the bottom band; unexplained "TOM"; no voice or CTA; it ends mid page-turn.
lumebook_takeaway: Film one static top-down take of a LumeBook page, with a numbered "questions to ask your child" headline on screen from 0:00, and reveal them one by one.
not_verified: The audio (no speech, not silent at mean -16.1 dB, no sticker, so likely music, unconfirmed); the book's author and publisher; that the creator is a speech therapist (handle and caption only). Corrections to the first pass: the book's title is in the headline box, not only in the caption; the third question sits at about 73% down, inside the bottom 35%; there are no borders; the Reel ends mid page-turn. Plays 2,071, likes 38 on 15 Oct are context only. Lead edit 18 Oct: resolution remarks removed, because the downloaded copy can be smaller than what was posted.
